what: Three killed in Moscow restaurant explosion

clean_source_blocks.text: At least three people have been killed and 15 injured in an explosion at a restaurant in Moscow, police say. The blast happened at around 20:00 local time (17:00 GMT) on Kudrinskaya square near the city centre. The cause is not clear but the Baza Telegram channel said it happened in the establishment's kitchen. A witness told the channel the venue was hosting a wedding reception attended by about 50 people, adding that they saw people being brought out covered in blood after the explosion. Roads around the square were briefly closed. Dozens of cyclists had been gathering nearby for an evening ride through the city but the event was cancelled. Video released by Russia's RIA news agency showed heavily armed law enforcement officers at the scene, which had been closed off to members of the public. ---
The deadly blast took place in a venue near the centre of the city, but the cause is currently unclear.

Published by Global Banking & Finance Review MOSCOW, Aug 1 (Reuters) - Three people were killed and 15 injured in an explosion that went off near a summer restaurant terrace in central Moscow on Saturday evening, the Russian capital's police force said. The explosion occurred at around 2000 local time near a summer terrace located on the ground floor of one of Moscow's seven Stalin-era skyscrapers at Kudrinksaya Square, the police said. Those injured had received wounds of varying seriousness, it said. Investigators and emergency services were working at the scene. Russian state TV suggested the explosion may have been caused by a gas canister detonating. Reuters could not confirm that. Russia's state RIA news agency released video of heavily armed law enforcement officers at the scene, which had been closed off to the public.

A gas leak near the Italian cafe-restaurant Balzi Rossi was suspected to be the cause, according to unconfirmed reports on social media An explosion on Saturday near a Moscow cafe killed at least three people and wounded another 15, police said, without saying what caused the blast. “From the information we have, an explosion happened today at around 8.10pm near a summer cafe, causing three deaths and 15 injured, of varying degrees of seriousness,” Moscow police told state news agency RIA Novosti. Investigators and police forensic specialists were on site, the statement added. Images posted on Russian Telegram channels showed fire engines and ambulances at the site.

At least three people have been killed and 15 injured in an explosion at a restaurant in Moscow, police say.

The blast happened at around 20:00 local time (17:00 GMT) on Kudrinskaya square near the city centre. The cause is not clear but the Baza Telegram channel said it happened in the establishment's kitchen.

A witness told the channel the venue was hosting a wedding reception attended by about 50 people, adding that they saw people being brought out covered in blood after the explosion.

Roads around the square were briefly closed. Dozens of cyclists had been gathering nearby for an evening ride through the city but the event was cancelled.

Video released by Russia's RIA news agency showed heavily armed law enforcement officers at the scene, which had been closed off to members of the public.

---

[Lähde: scmp.com | URL: https://www.scmp.com/news/world/russia-central-asia/article/3362666/3-dead-15-injured-explosion-near-moscow-cafe-police-say]
A gas leak near the Italian cafe-restaurant Balzi Rossi was suspected to be the cause, according to unconfirmed reports on social media

An explosion on Saturday near a Moscow cafe killed at least three people and wounded another 15, police said, without saying what caused the blast.

“From the information we have, an explosion happened today at around 8.10pm near a summer cafe, causing three deaths and 15 injured, of varying degrees of seriousness,” Moscow police told state news agency RIA Novosti.

Investigators and police forensic specialists were on site, the statement added.

Images posted on Russian Telegram channels showed fire engines and ambulances at the site.

According to the Baza Telegram channel, the explosion was caused by a gas blast in the cafe’s kitchens. ⁠The news outlet, which has good contacts with the police, said the explosion happened at the ‌upscale Balzi Rossi Italian restaurant.

The restaurant’s website said the venue, located in the wider city centre of the Russian capital, had been closed on Saturday for a private event.

---

[Lähde: Global Banking & Finance Review | URL: https://www.globalbankingandfinance.com/three-killed-15-injured-moscow-explosion-tass/]
Published by   Global Banking & Finance Review

MOSCOW, Aug 1 (Reuters) - Three people were killed and 15 injured in an explosion that went off near a summer restaurant terrace in central Moscow on Saturday evening, the Russian capital's police force said.

The explosion occurred at around 2000 local time near a summer terrace located on the ground floor of one of Moscow's seven Stalin-era skyscrapers at Kudrinksaya Square, the police said. Those injured had received wounds of varying seriousness, it said.

Investigators and emergency services were working at the scene.

Russian state TV suggested the explosion may have been caused by a gas canister detonating. Reuters could not confirm that.

Russia's state RIA news agency released video of heavily armed law enforcement officers at the scene, which had been closed off to the public.

The Baza online news outlet, which has good contacts with law enforcement, said the explosion had occurred at the upscale Balzi Rossi Italian restaurant. The restaurant's website said the venue had been closed on Saturday for a private event.

(Reporting by Reuters Editing by Andrew Osborn )

[Lähde: EADaily | URL: https://eadaily.com/en/news/2026/08/01/an-explosion-in-a-moscow-cafe-injured-20-people]
Twenty people, according to preliminary information, as a result of an explosion in a cafe in the center of Moscow.

The incident occurred on Kudrinskaya Square near the Stalin high-rise. Eyewitnesses report an explosion in the restaurant "Balzi Rossi". Dozens of ambulance crews and significant forces of the Ministry of Emergency Situations have been sent to the site.

The explosion occurred on the first floor of a high-rise building in the Balzi Rossi restaurant, according to sources of the Telegram channel 112.

After the explosion, a fire started. According to the Telegram channel Baza, the fire was assigned the third rank of complexity.

According to eyewitnesses, intensive care vehicles have accumulated on the spot. The roads around the high-rise are blocked.

payload.title: Kolme kuoli ravintolan lähellä tapahtuneessa räjähdyksessä Moskovassa
payload.summary: Kolme ihmistä kuoli ja 15 loukkaantui räjähdyksessä Moskovan keskustan tuntumassa. Poliisi ei ole vahvistanut räjähdyksen syytä.
payload.content:
Moskovan keskustan tuntumassa tapahtuneessa räjähdyksessä kuoli lauantai-iltana kolme ihmistä ja loukkaantui 15, kaupungin poliisi kertoi. Räjähdys sattui ravintolan kesäterassin läheisyydessä Kudrinskajan aukiolla noin kello 20 paikallista aikaa. Viranomaiset eivät ole vahvistaneet räjähdyksen syytä, ja tapahtumapaikan tutkinta jatkui illalla.

Poliisin RIA Novostille välittämässä ensimmäisessä arviossa räjähdys ajoitettiin noin kello 20.10. Muissa alkuvaiheen tiedoissa ajaksi ilmoitettiin noin kello 20, joten tiedot sijoittavat tapahtuman samaan lyhyeen aikaikkunaan.

## Pelastus- ja tutkintatyöt käynnistyivät

Räjähdys tapahtui kesäterassin lähellä rakennuksen pohjakerroksessa. Rakennus on yksi Moskovan seitsemästä Stalinin ajan pilvenpiirtäjästä. Poliisi kuvasi loukkaantuneiden vammoja vakavuudeltaan vaihteleviksi. Tutkijat, pelastuspalvelut ja poliisin rikostekniset asiantuntijat työskentelivät tapahtumapaikalla illan aikana.

Aukion ympäristö eristettiin yleisöltä, ja läheisiä teitä suljettiin lyhyeksi aikaa. RIA Novostin julkaisemalla videolla tapahtumapaikalla näkyi raskaasti aseistautuneita lainvalvojia. Venäläisissä Telegram-kanavissa julkaistuissa kuvissa alueella näkyi paloautoja ja ambulansseja.

Lähistölle oli kokoontumassa kymmeniä pyöräilijöitä kaupungin läpi kulkevalle ilta-ajolle. Tapahtuma peruttiin räjähdyksen vuoksi.

## Silminnäkijä kertoi hääjuhlasta

Telegram-kanava Bazalle puhuneen silminnäkijän mukaan ravintolassa järjestettiin häävastaanottoa, johon osallistui noin 50 ihmistä. Silminnäkijä kertoi nähneensä ihmisiä tuotavan ulos veren peitossa räjähdyksen jälkeen. Poliisi ei vahvistanut tiedotteessaan juhlan osallistujamäärää tai silminnäkijän kuvausta.

## Räjähdyksen syy on edelleen epäselvä

Räjähdyksen syystä liikkui illan aikana useita keskenään erilaisia ja vahvistamattomia tietoja. Baza sijoitti räjähdyksen ravintolan keittiöön. Venäjän valtiontelevisiossa puolestaan arveltiin kaasupullon voineen räjähtää, mutta Reuters ei pystynyt vahvistamaan väitettä.

Sosiaalisessa mediassa esitettiin myös epäily kaasuvuodosta italialaisen Balzi Rossi -kahvilaravintolan läheisyydessä. Moskovan poliisi ei omassa lausunnossaan kertonut räjähdyksen syytä. Keittiöön, kaasupulloon ja kaasuvuotoon liittyvät selitykset olivat siten edelleen alustavia, eikä niiden perusteella voinut tehdä varmaa päätelmää tapahtumien kulusta.

Poliisin vahvistamia olivat kuolonuhrien ja loukkaantuneiden määrät sekä tutkinta- ja pelastustoimien käynnistyminen. Räjähdyksen tarkka syntytapa jäi vielä avoimeksi.

Twenty people, according to preliminary information, as a result of an explosion in a cafe in the center of Moscow.

The incident occurred on Kudrinskaya Square near the Stalin high-rise. Eyewitnesses report an explosion in the restaurant "Balzi Rossi". Dozens of ambulance crews and significant forces of the Ministry of Emergency Situations have been sent to the site.

The explosion occurred on the first floor of a high-rise building in the Balzi Rossi restaurant, according to sources of the Telegram channel 112.

After the explosion, a fire started. According to the Telegram channel Baza, the fire was assigned the third rank of complexity.

According to eyewitnesses, intensive care vehicles have accumulated on the spot. The roads around the high-rise are blocked.
article.summary: Kolme ihmistä kuoli ja 15 loukkaantui räjähdyksessä Moskovan keskustan tuntumassa. Poliisi ei ole vahvistanut räjähdyksen syytä.
article.content:
Moskovan keskustan tuntumassa tapahtuneessa räjähdyksessä kuoli lauantai-iltana kolme ihmistä ja loukkaantui 15, kaupungin poliisi kertoi. Räjähdys sattui ravintolan kesäterassin läheisyydessä Kudrinskajan aukiolla noin kello 20 paikallista aikaa. Viranomaiset eivät ole vahvistaneet räjähdyksen syytä, ja tapahtumapaikan tutkinta jatkui illalla.

Poliisin RIA Novostille välittämässä ensimmäisessä arviossa räjähdys ajoitettiin noin kello 20.10. Muissa alkuvaiheen tiedoissa ajaksi ilmoitettiin noin kello 20, joten tiedot sijoittavat tapahtuman samaan lyhyeen aikaikkunaan.

## Pelastus- ja tutkintatyöt käynnistyivät

Räjähdys tapahtui kesäterassin lähellä rakennuksen pohjakerroksessa. Rakennus on yksi Moskovan seitsemästä Stalinin ajan pilvenpiirtäjästä. Poliisi kuvasi loukkaantuneiden vammoja vakavuudeltaan vaihteleviksi. Tutkijat, pelastuspalvelut ja poliisin rikostekniset asiantuntijat työskentelivät tapahtumapaikalla illan aikana.

Aukion ympäristö eristettiin yleisöltä, ja läheisiä teitä suljettiin lyhyeksi aikaa. RIA Novostin julkaisemalla videolla tapahtumapaikalla näkyi raskaasti aseistautuneita lainvalvojia. Venäläisissä Telegram-kanavissa julkaistuissa kuvissa alueella näkyi paloautoja ja ambulansseja.

Lähistölle oli kokoontumassa kymmeniä pyöräilijöitä kaupungin läpi kulkevalle ilta-ajolle. Tapahtuma peruttiin räjähdyksen vuoksi.

## Silminnäkijä kertoi hääjuhlasta

Telegram-kanava Bazalle puhuneen silminnäkijän mukaan ravintolassa järjestettiin häävastaanottoa, johon osallistui noin 50 ihmistä. Silminnäkijä kertoi nähneensä ihmisiä tuotavan ulos veren peitossa räjähdyksen jälkeen. Poliisi ei vahvistanut tiedotteessaan juhlan osallistujamäärää tai silminnäkijän kuvausta.

## Räjähdyksen syy on edelleen epäselvä

Räjähdyksen syystä liikkui illan aikana useita keskenään erilaisia ja vahvistamattomia tietoja. Baza sijoitti räjähdyksen ravintolan keittiöön. Venäjän valtiontelevisiossa puolestaan arveltiin kaasupullon voineen räjähtää, mutta Reuters ei pystynyt vahvistamaan väitettä.

Sosiaalisessa mediassa esitettiin myös epäily kaasuvuodosta italialaisen Balzi Rossi -kahvilaravintolan läheisyydessä. Moskovan poliisi ei omassa lausunnossaan kertonut räjähdyksen syytä. Keittiöön, kaasupulloon ja kaasuvuotoon liittyvät selitykset olivat siten edelleen alustavia, eikä niiden perusteella voinut tehdä varmaa päätelmää tapahtumien kulusta.

Poliisin vahvistamia olivat kuolonuhrien ja loukkaantuneiden määrät sekä tutkinta- ja pelastustoimien käynnistyminen. Räjähdyksen tarkka syntytapa jäi vielä avoimeksi.

article.source_text:
At least three people have been killed and 15 injured in an explosion at a restaurant in Moscow, police say. The blast happened at around 20:00 local time (17:00 GMT) on Kudrinskaya square near the city centre. The cause is not clear but the Baza Telegram channel said it happened in the establishment's kitchen. A witness told the channel the venue was hosting a wedding reception attended by about 50 people, adding that they saw people being brought out covered in blood after the explosion. Roads around the square were briefly closed. Dozens of cyclists had been gathering nearby for an evening ride through the city but the event was cancelled. Video released by Russia's RIA news agency showed heavily armed law enforcement officers at the scene, which had been closed off to members of the public. ---

The deadly blast took place in a venue near the centre of the city, but the cause is currently unclear.

Published by Global Banking & Finance Review MOSCOW, Aug 1 (Reuters) - Three people were killed and 15 injured in an explosion that went off near a summer restaurant terrace in central Moscow on Saturday evening, the Russian capital's police force said. The explosion occurred at around 2000 local time near a summer terrace located on the ground floor of one of Moscow's seven Stalin-era skyscrapers at Kudrinksaya Square, the police said. Those injured had received wounds of varying seriousness, it said. Investigators and emergency services were working at the scene. Russian state TV suggested the explosion may have been caused by a gas canister detonating. Reuters could not confirm that. Russia's state RIA news agency released video of heavily armed law enforcement officers at the scene, which had been closed off to the public.

A gas leak near the Italian cafe-restaurant Balzi Rossi was suspected to be the cause, according to unconfirmed reports on social media An explosion on Saturday near a Moscow cafe killed at least three people and wounded another 15, police said, without saying what caused the blast. “From the information we have, an explosion happened today at around 8.10pm near a summer cafe, causing three deaths and 15 injured, of varying degrees of seriousness,” Moscow police told state news agency RIA Novosti. Investigators and police forensic specialists were on site, the statement added. Images posted on Russian Telegram channels showed fire engines and ambulances at the site.
